The '''White Tower Library''', sometimes called the '''Great Library''', is generally considered the largest and most complete library in the world. It is only partially open to outsiders.

==Description and location==
Located inside the [[Aes Sedai]] compound and adjacent to the [[White Tower]], it is second only to the Tower itself in size.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24}} It incorporates many offices and workrooms, with many assigned to Aes Sedai of the [[Brown Ajah]]. The library is divided into twelve publicly acknowledged depositories as well as a [[Thirteenth Depository|thirteenth]] that is only accessible to the [[Amyrlin Seat]], the [[Keeper of the Chronicles]] and the [[Hall of the Tower|Sitters of the Hall of the Tower]].

The [[Ninth Depository]]: The Smallest of the Depositories, this is reserved for texts concerning various forms of arithmetic. It is a single, large oval chamber with a flattened dome ceiling and seven-colored floor tiles.{{ref/book|10|19}}

==History of the Great Library==
It has suffered only three known destructive events. The first, occurring during the fourth assault of Tar Valon during the [[Trolloc Wars]], resulted in the most damage. Minor damage was done to the library during the Great Fire of {{Fy|642}}. The latest, during [[Artur Hawkwing|Hawkwing's]] time, was suspected to be deliberate arson on the part of the Aes Sedai, who may not have wished Hawkwing to learn certain things.
